items.scope: GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
ASUSTOR issues only.
Pure Storage products only.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All ServiceNow products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ServiceNow that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Western Digital products including WD, SanDisk, SanDisk Professional, G-Technology, and HGST only.
Synaptics issues only.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Pegasystems products only.
Lexmark products only.

Root Scope: European Union (EU) member states/EU authorities, EU CSIRTs network members, and cooperative partners under ENISA’s mandate as well as other CNAs who choose ENISA as their Root.

CNA Scope: Vulnerabilities in information technology (IT) products discovered by European Union (EU) Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRTs) or reported to EU CSIRTs for coordinated disclosure, as long as they do not fall under a CNA with a more specific scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
All ISC.org projects.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
Roche’s medical technology products.
Digi branded products and services only.
Microchip Technology products only.
Third-party products it researches.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Root Scope: Japan organizations.
CNA Scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
Kubernetes issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Ribose products and services, including open source projects, supported products, and end-of-life/end-of-service products.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in Honor products and services unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
SailPoint issues only.
Zscaler issues only.

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Cisco will not issue a CVE ID for issues reported on products that are past the Last Day of Support milestone, as defined on Cisco’s End-of-Life Policy, which is available at https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-policy.html.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Juniper issues only.
Switzerland Government Common Vulnerability Program.
All HCL products only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Azure Access branded products and technologies only.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.

Only supported and end-of-life Python versions available at https://python.org/downloads and pip versions available at https://pypi.org/project/pip, Pallets projects available at https://github.com/pallets (such as Flask, Jinja, Click, MarkupSafe, Werkzeug, and ItsDangerous), and excluding distributions of Python, pip, and Pallets projects maintained by third-party redistributors.
